description: This file defines classes, functions, and enums for managing subprocesses, including starting, stopping, signaling, and waiting for subprocesses, as well as handling their IO channels and environment. It provides an abstraction for process control within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: Subprocess
classes.description: Represents a running subprocess, providing methods to wait for completion, send signals, and stop the process.

classes.name: SubprocessOptions
classes.description: Configures options for starting a subprocess, such as verbosity, environment, and process group settings.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Represents a command to be executed as a subprocess, allowing configuration of executable, arguments, environment, IO redirection, and prerequisites.

methods.name: ArgsToVec
methods.description: Converts command-line arguments to a vector of strings.

methods.name: EnvpToMap
methods.description: Converts environment variables array to a map.

methods.name: KillSubprocess
methods.description: Kills a subprocess by sending SIGKILL.

methods.name: KillSubprocessFallback
methods.description: Creates a stopper that first tries a given stopper, then falls back to KillSubprocess.

methods.name: Subprocess::Wait
methods.description: Waits for the subprocess to complete, returning its exit status.

methods.name: Subprocess::SendSignal
methods.description: Sends a signal to the subprocess.

methods.name: Subprocess::SendSignalToGroup
methods.description: Sends a signal to the process group of the subprocess.

methods.name: SubprocessOptions::ExitWithParent
methods.description: Configures whether the subprocess should exit when the parent exits.

methods.name: SubprocessOptions::SandboxArguments
methods.description: Sets sandbox arguments for the subprocess.

methods.name: SubprocessOptions::InGroup
methods.description: Configures whether the subprocess runs in its own process group.

methods.name: SubprocessOptions::Strace
methods.description: Sets strace output path for the subprocess.

methods.name: Command::BuildParameter
methods.description: Helper template to build command parameters.

methods.name: Command::Start
methods.description: Starts execution of the command as a subprocess.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes a command sequence, returning the exit status.

methods.name: RunWithManagedStdio
methods.description: Runs a command with managed stdio channels.
